newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Max 0.5% GDP fine for high deficit EMU members - EU.
newsitem.headline: Max 0.5% GDP fine for high deficit EMU members - EU.

text.p: European Union commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy said on Wednesday the maximum fine which could be imposed by the Commission on EMU members with excessive budget deficits would be 0.5 percent of gross domestic product (GDP).

De Silguy was addressing a news conference after a commission meeting on economic convergence between European Union members, the legal status of the euro -- Europe's future single currency -- , and a stability pact for EU members which will have joined the economic and monetary union (EMU).
The proposed fine will be discussed by European Finance Ministers in the coming weeks with a final agreement expected by the time of the summit of EU leaders in Dublin in December.
